issue_notes: No. 138 (1903 Q2): no arms-trade rows found. From 1903 the Kowloon import table is shortened and no longer lists Saltpetre or Sulphur (the Foreign Sundries list runs Rice and Paddy, Sandalwood, Sapanwood, Seaweed, Stock-fish), so the series recorded for 1890-1902 stops here. Keyword hits in this issue are antimony and arsenic ores, joss-stick powder and month headings misread as 'Arms', none of which are arms trade.
